title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As pretraining scaling laws approach saturation, Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as an important direction for improving reasoning by allocating inference-time compute to a fixed model prior. Viewed at a high level, TTS reframes inference as search over a space of partial reasoning states. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exposes intermediate steps, common instantiations rely on single-trajectory decoding, limiting recovery from early errors and exploration. This survey systematizes recent progress in tree-search-based reasoning, viewing inference as instance-specific optimization rather than decoding. We trace the evolution from uninformed search to Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), highlighting how sampling-based control supports principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs. translated_title: 当大语言模型遇见树搜索：将推理视为大语言模型中搜索的系统性视角
translated_abstract: 随着预训练缩放定律逐渐趋于饱和，测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）已成为一个重要方向，它通过为固定的模型先验分配推理时计算资源来提升推理能力。从高层视角来看，TTS 将推理重新定义为在部分推理状态空间上的搜索。虽然思维链揭示了中间步骤，但常见的实现方式依赖于单轨迹解码，这限制了从早期错误中恢复以及进行探索的能力。本综述系统梳理了基于树搜索的推理的最新进展，将推理视为针对特定实例的优化而非单纯的解码。我们追溯了从无信息搜索到蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的演进历程，重点阐述了基于采样的控制如何支持有原则的探索-利用权衡。为了统一碎片化的文献，我们引入了一个涵盖搜索拓扑、评估信号和控制动力学的统一设计空间，并倡导标准化……
tldr: 该综述系统梳理了基于树搜索的大语言模型推理方法，提出了一个涵盖搜索拓扑、评估信号和控制动力学的统一设计空间，将推理视为针对特定实例的优化而非单纯的解码。
en_tdlr: This survey systematizes tree-search-based reasoning in LLMs by introducing a Unified Design Space spanning search topology, evaluation signals, and control dynamics, reframing inference as instance-specific optimization rather than decoding.
